meta.title: Tactical Briefing Boot
meta.description: A four-beat holographic mission-briefing opening. The theater reveal starts uncolored: a white-hot seed rises and bursts into dense rays while the highlighted sector fill rises from below, then the halo dissipates leaving only the key data nodes. Holographic command-table uplink, operator access / systems check and a mission-start title complete the sequence. The map and HUD are drawn in code; Agnes generates only the terrain relief and holographic table plates. About 15 seconds, skippable, played once per application start.
